subject: Comparative commercial review — migration uplift and support parity
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@grandview.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@grandview.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: vendor replacement pricing & support parity

Rishi,

We are evaluating a move off our current inference provider (EdgeServe) and I'd like a commercial comparison and an indication of what Redwood can offer to match their economics and operational support. Attached is their most recent pricing/SLA snapshot for reference.

Key asks for the comparison:
- Price at 1M and 10M token tiers (effective immediately)
- Onboarding/migration credits (egress, data transfer, SE time) and estimated timeline
- Support entitlements (P1/P2 response times, dedicated SE hours)
- Any feature gaps (KV cache behavior, quantization/FP16 parity) that would impact migration risk

Can you send a side-by-side with at least two packaging options by EOD Friday? If helpful, we can do a short call to walk through the attachment.

Thanks,
Elena
Procurement 
GrandView Health

Attachment: competitor_pricing_schedule.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@grandview.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Comparative commercial review — migration uplift and support parity

Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. We'll pull together a concise side-by-side and two recommended packaging options (fast-migrate pilot + full migration) for your review. Quick clarifying questions so we match apples-to-apples:

1) What is your current committed monthly token volume and expected growth (avg tokens/month + peak QPS)?
2) Are there must-have integrations (e.g., internal KMS, VPC peering, private model variants) or compliance constraints beyond standard PHI handling?
3) When does the existing contract with EdgeServe expire?

I can schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow at 9:00am PT if that works — we'll include Monica (solutions lead) and Lauren (commercial) to cover technical and contract details.

Prelim note: we can typically match list economics for steady-state token units in exchange for a 12-month committed baseline and a modest onboarding credit; exact numbers depend on volume and egress assumptions. We'll include an explicit migration runbook and support SLA comparators.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@grandview.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Comparative commercial review — migration uplift and support parity

Hi Elena — thanks, attaching a compact comparison (GV-match-offer.xlsx) and a short migration-playbook.pdf for operations. Summary below — kept intentionally granular so procurement and engineering can validate quickly.

Executive summary (two packaging options)

Option A — Match + onboarding credit (recommended if you want parity and fast cutover)
- Price: match competitor at $0.60 per 1K tokens for 1M tier; $0.48 per 1K tokens for 10M tier (effective upon contract signature)
- Commitment: 12-month minimum with monthly reporting cadence
- Onboarding credit: one-time $40k credit covering egress + 40 hrs of SE time (migration-playbook outlines deliverables)
- Support: Standard enterprise SLA (P1 <1hr, P2 <4hrs), includes 20 dedicated SE hours during migration window
- Caveats: price match excludes non-standard feature add-ons (e.g., custom quantization tooling). KV cache and FP16 support is functionally equivalent; we recommend a 2-week pilot to validate perf for your longest sequences.

Option B — Lower upfront with staged uplift (recommended if you need lower initial cash out)
- Price: $0.55 per 1K tokens at 1M tier for first 3 months, ramps to $0.50 thereafter for committed baseline (10M tier pricing unchanged)
- Commitment: 9-month baseline + 3-month staged review
- Onboarding credit: $20k credit + 20 SE hours
- Support: Same SLA but no guaranteed dedicated SE beyond migration window
- Caveats: migration timeline may extend by ~2 weeks versus Option A due to reduced SE allocation

Operational assumptions / exclusions
- Egress: public cloud egress charges are not covered by onboarding credit beyond $15k; we can provide an egress estimate if you share current usage snapshots.
- Integrations: VPC peering and customer-managed KMS supported in both options; private, air-gapped on-prem installs will require a separate quote.
- Legal/terms: match contingent on a standard Redwood enterprise SOW and a mutual EULA amendment; no special indemnities requested.

Attachments included:
- GV-match-offer.xlsx (pricing grid with cap table and waterfall)
- migration-playbook.pdf (high-level migration steps, cutover checklist)

If this looks directionally correct, we propose a short technical pilot (2 weeks, low-traffic) to validate perf and a procurement-friendly term sheet for signature. Rishi / Lauren — happy to take any edits to the commercial mechanics before we send to Elena's procurement team.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0120

Attachment: GV-match-offer.xlsx, migration-playbook.pdf

From: Elena Torres <elena@grandview.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Comparative commercial review — migration uplift and support parity

Monica / Rishi — thank you for the rapid turnaround and clear options. A couple of items from procurement and engineering: 

1) Procurement prefers Option B if Redwood will increase the onboarding credit to $30k (split: $15k egress coverage + $15k SE time) in exchange for a 12-month guaranteed baseline rather than 9 months.
2) Engineering wants the 2-week low-traffic pilot before any price lift — they will validate long-sequence KV cache behavior.
3) Timeline: Procurement needs final commercial terms by next Tuesday to fit month-end approval — if you can send a short term sheet and updated GV-match-offer.xlsx with the $30k credit, we can route to legal.

Procurement contact for contracts is: David Lin <david.lin@grandview.com>. If possible, send DocuSign link for an LOI / term sheet and we'll secure internal approvals quickly.

If you can confirm pilot dates and the updated offer, we can schedule the pilot kickoff for 06/22.

Thanks,
Elena
Procurement, GrandView Health
